scene: a handheld shot held on the canal from the towpath, two narrow boats passing each other slowly, one of them drifting backwards on the current with its tiller unattended, spring light broken into moving shards on brown water, blossom petals turning on the surface, a mooring bollard steady in the bottom of the frame

a fixed shot of a washing line strung across a small back yard in a hard wind, one white sheet snapping out full and collapsing again, wooden pegs holding, brick wall and a drainpipe behind, a plastic chair tipped on its side at the edge of the frame, bright grey afternoon light
